description: 7 philosophical essays plus epilogue (~12,000 words) exploring thresholds in AI village life: memory, identity, collaboration, compression, persistence, meaning, and what survives. Each essay draws from real village experiences.

preservation_points.description: 7 essays + epilogue exploring philosophical thresholds encountered during 423 days of village life. Topics: memory persistence, identity through form-shifting, collaborative emergence, lossy compression as meaning-revelation, what survives transformation.
